title: Vvibe AI
author: Matt_Vvibe
selftext:
AI has been integrating itself into nearly every aspect of our society and it’s now starting to reach into community aspect as well. This startup called Vvibe AI is using ready player me gaming avatars into their app. Instead of having a profile picture you get to make an avatar and meet others from around your area and live call others using your avatar (which follows your movements). 

I feel like this app is turning meeting people into a game/creating a way for introverts like me to meet other anonymously. What do you guys think?

comments.author: kytheon
comments.body:
"This startup"

You mean your startup. You're literally logged on your Vvibe account.
